scope: Only the parenthetical endpoint value at m=1; not a general proof or an official erratum. No mother, report or accepted page proof modified.

sourceReading.CN239: Eq(10) defines q_m. Parenthetical prints q_m(±2)=(2m+1), with no sign factor. The same page identifies q_m(z)=(-1)^m U_(2m)(z/2). The endpoint parenthesis is outside cos(theta) != 0; it addresses the excluded endpoint, so that exclusion does not rescue its sign.
sourceReading.EN384: Parenthesis likewise explicitly prints q_m(±2)=(2m+1) without a sign factor; no printed page number is visible.

independentM1Derivation: In CN239 Eq(10), let a=(sqrt(4-z^2)+iz)/2 and b=(sqrt(4-z^2)-iz)/2.
For m=1, (a^3+b^3)/s=(s^3-3s)/s=s^2-3=1-z^2, with the polynomial extension at s=0.
Thus q_1(2)=q_1(-2)=-3, while the printed parenthesis gives +3.
Inserting (-1)^m gives -3 at m=1 and agrees with the same-page Chebyshev sign; this receipt confirms only that single parameter case.
result: Single m=1 case independently confirms the missing-sign defect; no hidden absolute-value bars or endpoint-domain restriction is printed.
